subject: The 2AM text she almost ignored
preview_text: One user scanned a 'nothing' message and found the pattern that saved her 2 years. This buried feature is why.
body_paragraphs: A woman named Jess scanned a text at 2AM because she 'had a gut feeling.' It looked harmless — just a short reply from her boyfriend. The app flagged it as subtle gaslighting. She almost deleted the scan.

That one scan connected to 14 other screenshots she'd taken over 3 months. The pattern was invisible to her: he'd apologize, then do it again. The Relationship Health Dashboard showed her toxicity score climbing across conversations. She said it was like seeing the Matrix.

You already have this dashboard. It's under the Pattern Detection tab. It scans every chat you've ever run and shows you the invisible loops — love bombing cycles, manipulation arcs, the way they shift blame. Most people don't open it because they think they 'already know.' You don't.

Open your app. Tap Pattern Detection. Let the dashboard show you what your gut has been screaming. P.S. Jess left him 3 weeks later. She says the dashboard saved her from 'another 2 years of the same fight.'
